instructions: Implement the smallest production Task-linked two-role mailbox consuming CW-05/G3 public bridge contracts and CW-09 TaskRepository public message/delivery APIs without changing the storage schema. Support task/question/answer/report in the correct manager↔worker direction and require durable task_id/revision/run_id/message_id linkage. Use stable logical message_id with separate append-only delivery attempts. Immediately before injection, fail closed unless role/session generation, pending/approval/busy/composer readiness are current. Record API method return separately from matching OMP processing observation; never treat method return as delivered or Task completion. Dedupe a logical message on a live connection, preserve unknown/asynchronous error evidence, do not auto-replay unknown attempts or inject prior-process/session requests after reopen, and do not disturb user composer input. Reuse existing public extension seams; do not introduce mutable native-tool wrappers. Add deterministic tests plus a bounded actual two-OMP runtime probe using the pinned OMP setup that establishes task/question/answer/report roundtrip and duplicate suppression with cleanup/residue evidence. Include negative cases for pending/approval/composer/busy, session generation changes, ACK loss/async error, and restart/reopen no-replay. Do not implement downstream CW-10/CW-15 orchestration. Run bridge tests, relevant task/contracts/G3/G4 compatibility checks, real runtime, and git diff --check. Produce result/raw runtime/snapshot/scope audit and return writer lease. Root owns graphify update.
